summary: Aqua Metals filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that The Benchmark Company assigned its rights and obligations under the August 30, 2024 ATM Sales Agreement to affiliate StoneX Financial Inc., effective September 2, 2026. The assignment was permitted under Section 13 without company consent. Terms like commission rate, share price/volume cap, and proceeds were unchanged. The at-the-market program remains the same, just serviced by a different broker-dealer. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, close date, or regulatory clock applies.
